inputs.text: A single milky ivory round medicinal pellet, smooth waxy surface, clear charcoal outer contour, broad soft shading, small white highlight on the upper right, resting on folded beige paper, slightly elevated front view, simple hand drawn 2D inventory icon. Three broad indigo blue horizontal flowing wave lines, smooth parallel curves, generous ivory gaps, no splashes. The colored motif is a flat surface marking following the sphere, crisp broad strokes, most of the pellet stays ivory. Isolated on flat magenta background.
